query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='gorhill/uBlock' AND number=1647 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Suggestion: Prevent AudioContext fingerprinting
data.body:
Princeton's [WebTAP](https://webtap.princeton.edu/) recently discovered several tracking scripts utilizing [`AudioContext`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AudioContext) API and its related interfaces to reveal browser and device combination. Different device and browser might process audio signal differently and such difference is used for fingerprinting. This differs from tracking using inaudible audio. However, currently such script could only be found in 512 sites of the top 1 million sites.

[Paper](http://randomwalker.info/publications/OpenWPM_1_million_site_tracking_measurement.pdf)
[Main website](https://webtap.princeton.edu/)
[OpenWPM github](https://github.com/citp/OpenWPM)

data.title: Suggestion: Prevent AudioContext fingerprinting
data.body: Anti-fingerprinting features are best left to a dedicated separate extension -- which would requires constant work.
